english_text: Mr President , I do not want to open a debate on this matter , but as you rightly said , this is a matter of constitutional concern . Moreover , it is part of the legislative procedure . It would be very useful for the House to obtain information from the presidency of the Council regarding the reasons behind and the justifications for the four previously mentioned governments ' opposition to the Statute . We could then , perhaps , make progress . At this moment we do not know the reservations these governments have .
